name: callback-number-check
title: Callback Number Check
description: Reads a callback number's country and line type with libphonenumber and flags +1 Caribbean codes posing as US area codes, one-ring calls from abroad, premium-rate and shared-cost lines, foreign toll-free, unassigned ranges and 'bank' numbers missing from its list.

meta.stops: Called back a premium-rate scam number
meta.summary: Says what a number really is before you call it back, so a Caribbean, premium-rate or one-ring scam number isn't mistaken for a local one.
catches: +1 numbers in Caribbean countries that look like US area codes (e.g. 876 Jamaica)
One-ring missed calls from abroad (wangiri pattern)
Toll-free numbers that are only free in their own country, and unassigned ranges
A number claiming to be an organisation that isn't in the officialNumbers you pass
limits: Line types come from libphonenumber metadata, which can lag behind real number allocations
It cannot tell who owns a number or detect a spoofed caller ID
Risky calls still go through after a second press
a11y: Findings are a labelled list with icon plus text
The Call button is described by the status once armed for a second press
Status is announced in a role="status" region (visually hidden until armed)
